conflicts.remarks_quote: This method is relevant only for thin features.
conflicts.example_quote:
Debug.Print " Is a thin-walled sweep feature? " & swSweep.IsThinFeature
    Debug.Print " Thin-walled type (0=1D, 1=1DReverse, 2=MidPlane, 3=2D) = " & swSweep.ThinWallType
    Debug.Print " Wall thickness in Direction 1 = " & swSweep.GetWallThickness(True) * 1000# & " mm"
conflicts.why: Remarks 把有效性限定在薄壁特征；示例读出 IsThinFeature 后并不分支，直接调用，两条规则不能同时成立。

example_more_specific.what: 示例把返回值乘 1000 后按 mm 打印，说明返回单位是米；成员页 Returns 只写 Wall thickness，未给单位
example_more_specific.example_quote:
Debug.Print("    Wall thickness foward     = " & swSweep.GetWallThickness(True)
	* 1000.0# & " mm")
